scope: Population-selected common-SNP DNA/RNA compatibility, bounded local feasibility and QC; not patient identity or contamination quantification
universe: All165782 positions in frozen public-common-SNP-panel.tsv, selected without patient allele calls, on chr2/3/5/8/9/17
original_analysis_absent: Oct4 panel has DNA only. Oct1 DNA/RNA assay selected335 sites from patient high-ALT DNA calls; this is a distinct selection design.
alignment: Original coordinate-sorted Caris full RNA BAM (STAR2.7.8a), same fullDNA BAM; existing indexes. New full STAR2.7.11b BAM not retained by streamed design; restricted target-genes BAM usable only within retained BAP1/RASA1/LATS1/LATS2 intervals, with no broad inference.

primary_filters.BAQ: disabled for parity with prior DNA counts
primary_filters.mates: samtools overlap adjustment disabled, collapse by query name; discard qualifying conflicting ACGT mates. Both original BAM headers have a single matching RG; no UMI independence claimed.
primary_filters.denominator: all unambiguous ACGT name units = ref+alt+other; retain nonACGT and conflict counts separately
primary_filters.reuse_DNA: All62358 DNA-observed rows retained; all absent panel rows explicit zero, no patient-allele selection. Primary exact counts reuse existing validated DNA workflow.

callability.zero_rows: Missing DNA/RNA observed rows map to zero coverage in universe, not omitted
callability.reference_check: All selected REF alleles checked against resident GRCh38 FASTA; all six BAM contig lengths checked

categories.RNA_dominant_retention: >=0.90 and>=0.98 of specified DNA-dominant allele reported separately
categories.mixedDNA: RNA shifts/monoallelic expression not classified as sample incompatibility

operational_feasibility_gate.meaning: Breadth/workflow gate only, not clinical power or probability. If unmet, report sparse evidence and stop branch.

distribution: Full selection/coverage attrition by chromosome and panel scope; gene distribution/top concentrations; nearest-neighbor spacing; deterministic coordinate-first>=50kb-spaced subset selected without observed allele direction; no independence assumed. Report overlap with old335 marker set.
discordance_triage: Bothassays>=50ACGTnames; RNA unexpected allele>=10% and>=10names while DNA sameallele<=2%. Separately record opposite near-homozygous calls and third-allele excess. Audit all up to fixed20locus cap; if more, report cap and restrict claims rather than silently choose favorable subset.
independent_review: Direct CIGAR-count review of all joint sites if feasible; otherwise all prioritized discordances plus fixed stratified300 controls. Edge/no-softclip/MAPQ and new retained alignment sensitivity when relevant. Sequence/reference/paralog controls on actual discordances only.
resource_bounds: Local only, no new whole alignment/download; two processes maximum, RSS<=4GiB per process, free-disk guard3GiB, new artifacts <=1GiB before reassessment, analysis deadline6:15Eastern / package6:45Eastern. Each counted chromosome allows30min; stop on unexpected limits.
forbidden_inference: No identity certainty or chance-match probability
No contamination fraction or proof of absence
No clinical diagnosis, test or treatment decision
Population-selected surviving loci are not statistically independent
prior_v2: Preserve all completed v2 outputs unchanged; separately dated addendum only if informative; revise concise handoff only if useful content changes
